title: “最佳工作场所奖”特别类别投票延期
content:
Voting extended for special categories in the Best Places To Work Awards | GamesIndustry.biz
If you click on a link and make a purchase we may receive a small commission.
Read our editorial policy
.
Now that Gamescom is firmly behind us, the
GamesIndustry.biz
team is busy judging the entries for this year's Best Places To Work Awards. Entries have closed for our headline awards, which are judged based on anonymous employee feedback - but we have extended the deadline for nominations for our Special Awards, which reward excellence in specific fields.
Nominations for the below categories will be accepted until midnight on Monday 7th September. These awards are separate from the main BPTW categories, and are open to all UK businesses working in and with the games industry.
The Diversity Award
The Green Award
HR Hero Award
Training and Development Award
Education Award
Corporate Social Responsibility Award
Health and Well-Being Award
Nominations can be made by internal or external parties, and judging will be completed next week ahead of the awards ceremony on October 1st.
Tickets are still available for the
GamesIndustry.biz
HR Summit
, which this year is focused on the future of People & Work, and takes place during the day ahead of the Awards.
